parsed.rationale: Although the cluster is flagged as exact-duplicates with shared_field_count=1, the two types carry different names — 'TextHeightPreferenceKey' in 'WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift' (package app:WatchXYC) and 'ScrollOffsetPreferenceKey' in 'WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/Playcut Detail/PlaycutRowView.swift' (package app:iOS). PreferenceKey conformances in SwiftUI are intentionally small, single-field structs whose structural identity is coincidental: each encodes a distinct semantic concept (text height vs. scroll offset) scoped to its own view hierarchy. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated layout concerns and couple two separate app targets (WatchXYC and iOS) for no meaningful reuse gain. The structural similarity is an artifact of the SwiftUI PreferenceKey protocol's minimal required shape, not a sign of unintentional duplication.
